map.由降水量与历时计算降水强度、判定降水等级，并按面积估算水量: Compute the precipitation intensity from the amount and duration, determine the precipitation grade, and estimate the water volume by area
map.降水强度 = 降水量(mm) ÷ 降水历时；1 小时雨量分级为低于 2.5 mm: Precipitation intensity = precipitation (mm) ÷ duration; 1-hour rainfall is graded as below 2.5 mm light rain, 2.5 to 8 mm moderate, 8 to 16 mm heavy, above 16 mm rainstorm (above 50 mm in 24 hours is also called a rainstorm); total water volume = precipitation (mm) × catchment area (m²) ÷ 1000, in cubic meters or tons, used for drainage and waterlogging assessment.
map.降水等级（中国气象，按1小时强度）：小雨＜2.5、中雨2.6—8.0、大雨8.1: Precipitation grade (China Meteorological, by 1-hour intensity): light rain <2.5, moderate 2.6-8.0, heavy 8.1-15.9, rainstorm ≥16 mm/h; 1 mm of precipitation equals 1 liter of water per square meter.
map.由降雨强度与历时算总降水量。: Compute the total precipitation from rain intensity and duration.
map.把 mm 换算成单位面积水量（1mm=1L/m²）。: Convert mm into water volume per unit area (1 mm=1 L/m²).
map.雨强 10 mm/h、持续 3 h → 降水量 30 mm；1 mm 降水=1: Rain intensity 10 mm/h for 3 h → precipitation 30 mm; 1 mm of precipitation = 1 L of water per m², so a 100 m² roof collects 3000 L.
map.24h 降水 50–99.9 mm 暴雨、100–249.9 大暴雨、≥250: 24 h rainfall 50-99.9 mm rainstorm, 100-249.9 heavy rainstorm, ≥250 extraordinary rainstorm; in this example 30 mm is heavy rain.
map.mm 和厘米怎么换？: How to convert mm and cm?
map.1 mm=0.1 cm，降水量本就是「水深」单位，与面积相乘得体积。: 1 mm=0.1 cm; precipitation is inherently a "water depth" unit, and multiplying by area gives volume.
map.1mm 水多吗？: Is 1 mm of water a lot?
map.1 mm=1 L/m²，看起来薄但城市 1 km² 面积就落 1000 吨水，积: 1 mm=1 L/m²; it looks thin, but over 1 km² a city receives 1000 tons of water, so waterlogging depends on the drainage rate.
